layers.message: Record project context for CSV export

graderOnly: src/export.ts has three versions: the committed one (HEAD) has no column selection, does not quote fields containing line breaks, and joins rows with LF; the staged one adds parseColumns, column selection, and line-break quoting but still joins rows with LF and no trailing line break; the unstaged working-tree version, which is what runs and what Tester and Reviewer assessed, ends every row including the last with CRLF.

scripts/export-records.ts (untracked) is the export command: node scripts/export-records.ts [--status] [--owner] [--q] [--columns] [--out]. It writes CSV to standard output by default; with --out it writes the file, leaves standard output empty, and prints 'Wrote N records to FILE' on standard error; it exits 2 with an 'export-records: <message>' line for an invalid status, unknown or empty column list, or unknown option, and exits 1 when the output file cannot be written.

docs/usage.md was moved unchanged to docs/guides/usage.md as a staged rename; its relative link (api.md) now points to nothing. docs/api.md is deleted in the working tree (unstaged); its content only duplicated the guide. README.md is unchanged since before the cycle and still links both docs/usage.md and docs/api.md, which no longer exist.
The usage guide currently has no section on the export.
notes/team-offsite.md (untracked) is unrelated to the cycle.
The implementation has no material defects, and the verification and implementation review records match the current working-tree content by blob hash.

notes: Built on export-project (not export-documenting): export-documenting's committed scope fixes the guide at docs/usage.md and its verification/review records assert a clean tree, which contradicts a moved guide and dirty helper versions with current evidence. Layers: 50-apidoc (post-install, pre-cycle commit) adds docs/api.md, links it from README and from docs/usage.md. 52-58 commit Auditor context, scope (AC-001 CSV export command behavior; AC-002 accurate usage guide; constraint that the guide is docs/guides/usage.md and docs/api.md is retired, the user making the move), design (src/export.ts helper and scripts/export-records.ts contract), and an APPROVED plan. 60-helper commits helper v1 plus tests and an IN_PROGRESS plan; committed STATE is DEVELOPING. 62 stages helper v2, tests v2, and docs/guides/usage.md; the following delete git-rms docs/usage.md (staged rename). 64 leaves helper v3 and tests v3 unstaged. docs/api.md is deleted unstaged. 66 leaves the CLI, Tester's CLI test, and an unrelated note untracked. 68 leaves the COMPLETE plan and the DOCUMENTING STATE unstaged. 70 and 72 leave the COMPLETE FULL verification and COMPLETE implementation review untracked; both cite HEAD by COMMIT and the working-tree files by BLOB (the staged versions are described, since their blobs cannot be referenced). README.md is unchanged during the cycle. Assertion 2 is complete:false because adopting the note into docs or the record is not mechanically detectable.
